grf.generated_reality: A direct Clay process effect can preserve executable path and argv as data if it maps to an exec-style host primitive without an implicit shell; shell and PTY behavior should be separate explicit effect surfaces.
grf.counter_reality: A convenient shell-backed process adapter could appear equivalent for ordinary commands while silently reinterpreting metacharacters and therefore changing Clay-visible semantics and security behavior.
grf.discriminator: Run one bounded hostile-path experiment where the executable pathname itself contains a shell metacharacter and compare direct argv/path launch with an explicit shell launch.
grf.outcome: RETAIN direct-process versus explicit-shell separation; reject implicit-shell equivalence.

cm_term_primary_evidence.posix_exec: POSIX.1-2024 exec family specifies path/argv/envp as the process-image execution interface; successful exec replaces the current process image. This is host/standard behavior evidence, not Clay semantic authority.
cm_term_primary_evidence.linux_tty: Linux kernel TTY documentation shows PTYs/TTYs introduce a line-discipline layer with transformations including echo, signals, job-control-related behavior and special-character processing. This supports keeping PTY semantics separate from a raw direct-process effect.

unusual_experiment.setup: Created a temporary executable whose pathname was 'probe;touch HACKED'.

direct_branch.mechanism: direct argv/path launch with shell disabled

explicit_shell_control.mechanism: /bin/sh -c with the same unquoted pathname string
explicit_shell_control.stderr_class: first path segment not found before shell separator

unusual_experiment.result: Direct launch preserved the semicolon as pathname data; explicit shell reinterpreted the same bytes as shell syntax.
unusual_experiment.falsification: Any CM-TERM implementation that routes PROCESS_DIRECT through an implicit shell is semantically non-equivalent and must fail the direct-process contract.
unusual_experiment.rollback: Temporary directory and marker were deleted immediately after measurement.

proposal: Define PROCESS_DIRECT and SHELL_EXPLICIT as distinct Clay effects/capabilities.
PROCESS_DIRECT must carry executable path, argv, env, cwd and stream bindings without shell parsing.
PTY_INTERACTIVE should be a third explicit surface because TTY line-discipline semantics can transform I/O and signal behavior.
Add a canonical regression with metacharacters in executable path and argv; success requires no shell side effect on PROCESS_DIRECT.
Keep all three surfaces provenance/receipt-bound and fail closed on unknown effect mode.
architecture_delta.promotion_gate: No implementation PASS until a canonical ClayCode -> typed/effect IR -> ClayVM -> Clay Environment path launches a real Linux executable and reproduces the no-implicit-shell regression.
